title: Delete a named component from a schematic library
summary: Shows how to check that the active document is a SchLib, look up a component by library reference and delete it without a dialog through the Sch:DeleteComponentFromLibrary process, then confirm the deletion.
phrasings: remove a symbol from a SchLib
find a schematic library component by its library reference
check whether the active document is a schematic library
delete a library part without a confirmation dialog

commands.name: RemoveComponent
commands.description: Delete a named component from the active schematic library
